_comment: Shipped non-code assets that carry a third-party license. Every file under public/fonts must be recorded here and is pinned by sha256, so replacing a font without updating this record fails `gen:sbom-versions:check`. Name, version and copyright are read from the font file's own name table; the license is what that table points to.

assets.name: Inter (variable font, latin subset)
assets.licenseSource: the font's own name table (name ID 14) points to https://openfontlicense.org
